Short title and commencement

THE GWADAR PORT AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2021
THE
GWADAR PORT AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2021
[AS
PASSED BY THE NATIONAL ASSEMBLY]
A
BILL
further
to amend the Gwadar Port Authority Ordinance, 2002
WHEREAS it is
expedient further to amend the Gwadar Port Authority Ordinance, 2002 (LXXVII
of2002), for the purpose hereinafter appearing;
1. Short title and commencement. -
(1) This Act shall be called the Gwadar Port Authority (Amendment) Act, 2021.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

LXXVII of 2002.- In the Gwadar Port Authority Ordinance, 2002 (LXXVII of
2002), here in after referred to as the said Ordinance, in section 2, after
clause (g), the following new clause shall be inserted, namely.-,
"(ga)
division concerned" means the division to which the subject of - the
Authority stands allocated;".
